pages.text: A straw mat uses three consecutive slots in one column. Use an empty slot with a mat; it extends $(bold)toward the front$(reset). Use any part to try sleeping.$(br2)Stop the wagon in a reasonably level posture before sleeping. Players and maids stay asleep as the wagon moves afterward.

Mats let you sleep through the night while keeping your existing respawn setting. Use them in bed-compatible dimensions under normal sleeping conditions. The Nether and End show a message.$(br2)Sneak-use to remove a mat and wake its sleeper safely. Assembly preserves sleep; wake sleepers and clear space before restoring the wagon to blocks.

pages.heading: book.tm_wagon.recipe
pages.text: Use any planks, including modded planks. Mats use a consistent straw appearance.
